text:
clare-people-ops: Following up from the All-Hands Q&A 1: quick thread to capture unanswered travel/offsite/workspace ops questions. Drop anything else here and Ill add to the playbook draft.

raj-product: Thanks! Two quick ones: 1) international travel policy (per diems, visas)? 2) does Redwood cover visa fees for short-term contractor travel?

clare-people-ops: International: we provide a standard per diem based on destination (link in draft). Visa fees for employees are covered when travel is at the companys request; contractors handled case-by-case and should be escalated to People Ops + Legal. Well add examples to the playbook.

emma-hr: Also adding note: passports/renewals  we reimburse urgent renewal fees when travel is on short notice and pre-approved.

thomas-ops: Booking window question: how far in advance do we prefer booking flights/hotels for offsites?

clare-people-ops: Preferred: flights 4+ weeks ahead, hotels 2+ weeks. For company-run offsites we'll open a booking window and cover early-bird bookings. Last-minute bookings are ok but expect limited approvals for upgrades.

sarah-design: Childcare stipend during offsites? A few folks asked about this in my team.

clare-people-ops: Were piloting a childcare stipend for families attending multi-day offsites (covers local childcare up to a cap). Pilot details + eligibility will be in the playbook draft by EOD Friday.

booking-bot: Reminder: team offsite RSVP form closes 7 days before event. Link: https://intranet.redwood/offsites/rsvp

raj-product: Are we shipping an offsite code of conduct and travel safety checklist?

emma-hr: Yes  offsite code of conduct + emergency contacts + local health info will be mandatory reading for attendees. Well include a safety checklist (vaccinations/meds, emergency numbers, travel insurance options).

clare-people-ops: Travel insurance: company covers work-time travel. Personal side trips should be covered by personal insurance; we can provide recommended vendors.

expense-bot: Reimbursement reminder: one expense report per offsite trip preferred. Use tags: OFFSITE_NAME, PROJECT_CODE. Attach receipts and travel itinerary. Multi-currency receipts: include card statement item as proof.

anna-ceo: Quick roadmap add: leadership wants a consolidated "Offsite Playbook" (policy + logistics + budget templates) and improved desk-booking UX in the console by Q3. Well prioritize ease-of-use and accessibility (nursing rooms, quiet zones).

clare-people-ops: Noted. For desk hoteling: pilot opens next Tue in NY + SF. Priority rules: recurring bookings for on-call / accommodations for neurodiverse folks / nursing rooms reserved via ops. Please file accessibility requests via the workspace form.

sarah-design: Can teams request a block of rooms when the offsite city is selected (to stay together)? Process?

clare-people-ops: Yes  team leads can request room blocks via the Offsite Logistics form at least 6 weeks prior. Ops will try to secure blocks; costs charged to the teams budget unless otherwise approved.

thomas-ops: One last ops note: if travel requires early arrival for setup, request a pre-event allowance in the travel request for extra nights. Approvals will be routed to your manager + ops.

clare-people-ops: Ill add all of this to the draft playbook and post the link here when its ready. If anyone needs a 1:1 to clarify edge cases (visas, contractors, healthcare), DM me. :sparkles:
